dict.string: Fuzzy file and folder names plus ripgrep content matches under a configurable search root.

# Grep Files
Fuzzy file and folder names plus ripgrep content matches under one root. Type your keyword (default `f`), then a query: Return opens, Option+Return reveals, Command+Return copies, Tab shows Alfred's file actions.
## Configuration
Everything below lives in this workflow's **Configure Workflow…** window. Defaults are declared in `info.plist`; Alfred stores changes in `prefs.plist`. The same field reference is shipped as `CONFIGURATION.md` in the workflow folder.
- **Keyword** (`grep_keyword`, default `f`) — the one-word Alfred trigger. The Script Filter follows it, so save and use the new keyword. - **Search folder** (`search_root`, default `~`) — root to index and search recursively. `~` expands; hidden files are included and symlinks are not followed. - **Excluded folders** (`excludes_mode`, default `asimeow`) — skip dependency/build folders using `asimeow` config, `builtin` dev list, or `none` (baseline only). `.git`, `.svn`, `.hg`, and `.DS_Store` are always excluded. - **asimeow config path** (`asimeow_config`, default `~/.config/asimeow/config.yaml`) — YAML read in asimeow mode; missing/broken falls back to the built-in list. - **Extra excluded folders** (`extra_excludes`, default empty) — one entry per line (commas also work): a bare name (`build`), relative path (`Media/Audio Files`), dot suffix (`.logicproject`), or rg glob (`*.tmp`). Matched at any depth; leading `/` is ignored. - **File contents** (`content_enabled`, default on) — turn ripgrep content search on/off. Contents are deferred and always ranked below names. - **Maximum results** (`max_items`, default `30`, range 1-100) — total rows emitted; name hits always above content. - **Content hits per file** (`max_content_lines`, default `3`, range 1-10) — matching lines taken from one file. - **Folders** (`include_dirs`, default on) — include matching folders; Return reveals them in Finder. - **Editor command** (`editor_command`, default empty) — command for Enter on a content hit. Placeholders: `{path}`, `{line}`, `{col}`. Example: `code -g {path}:{line}:{col}`. Blank auto-detects `code`, `cursor`, `zed`, or `subl`, then `open`. - **Index refresh interval** (`index_ttl_seconds`, default `600`, range 0-86400) — seconds before a background rebuild; `0` rebuilds on every search.
Settings apply on the next search. See `CONFIGURATION.md` for examples, plist details, precedence, and troubleshooting.
One-word Alfred trigger. Default: f. The Script Filter keyword follows this value; save, then use the new keyword.
Root folder to index and search recursively. ~ expands to your home folder. Hidden files included; symlinks not followed. Default: ~.
How to skip dependency/build folders: asimeow config, the built-in dev list, or no extra exclusions. The .git/.svn/.hg/.DS_Store baseline always applies.
YAML config read when Excluded folders is asimeow. ~ expands. A missing or unreadable config falls back to the built-in list.
One entry per line (commas work too): bare name (build), relative path (Media/Audio Files), dot suffix (.logicproject), or rg glob. Matched at any depth. Changes rebuild the index.
Search inside files with ripgrep. Names still appear first; contents arrive from a background scan. Off = filename/folder search only.
Total rows emitted to Alfred (1-100). Name hits always rank above content. Default: 30.
Maximum matching lines shown per file (1-10). Default: 3.
Include matching folders. Return reveals a folder in Finder. Empty folders cannot be indexed. Default: on.
Command for Enter on a content hit. Placeholders: {path}, {line}, {col}. Example: code -g {path}:{line}:{col}. Blank = auto-detect code, cursor, zed, or subl; else open.
Seconds before the name index is refreshed in the background (0-86400; 0 = every search). The old index is served while rebuilding. Default: 600.
